flavourText: *This elusive energy-rich planet was the desperate destination of the secret Lazax diaspora. Now, it is a technological nightmare.*

name: 99-Omega
legendaryAbilityText: This system is considered to not have any planets. When you exhaust this planet for its technology skip, you may explore a frontier token in this system, if one is present, or place one if not.

name: Abaddon
flavourText: *A temperate planet whose low gravity allows for stunningly tall mountain ranges. Serves as a stop-over for trade routes to the nearby Vorish Cluster.*

name: Abyz
flavourText: *Its thick, complex atmosphere is inhospitable to most races, but Abyz is known for its seemingly endless natural reserves of rare minerals and precious metals.*

name: Accoen
flavourText: *Populace lives on continent sized fungal rafts that float atop a soupy, world-spanning ocean of useful bio-compounds. Popular research site for biologists.*

name: Acheron
flavourText: *Once a dusty, dead world concealing a portal to Ixth. Now, a gravity rift has shattered the world, creating a labyrinth of strange energies and tumbling shards of rock.*

name: Adrian
flavourText: A bleak wasteland of toxic gas, the most accessible parts of the planetary surface are covered in tailings and industrial waste from nearby Telahas.

name: Akhassi
flavourText: While its surface is barren, sprawling undergound cities house millions. It has served as a vault for valuable artifacts and data-matrices.

name: Ako.4.0.m
legendaryAbilityText: At the end of your turn, you may exhaust this card to roll a die. On a result of 1-3 purge each attachment to this planet, and remove all units on this planet from the game board. Otherwise, attach an Improvement card to this planet. Improvement: ATTACH: This planet's resource and influence values are each increased by 1.
flavourText: Actively being torn apart by a gravity rift. A fact that itself does not deter the brave. Mining operations have remained strong even as the planet is full further towards its doom.

name: Alio Prima
flavourText: *Wet planet covered in rivers, lakes and small seas but no oceans. Dry poles provide haven from constant floods. Numerous farms famous for luxury foodstuffs.*

name: Alpert
legendaryAbilityText: This planet has the PRODUCTION 2 ability as if it were a unit. When you produce ships in this planet's system, reduce their combined cost by 1.

name: Ang
flavourText: *High rotational speed creates extremely energized magnetosphere. Orbital taps use this to energize starship fuels and power labs developing new beam weapons.*

name: Aranndan
flavourText: As a key fuel and weaponry supplier in its sector, Aranndan wields unusual power in the diplomatic halls of the galaxy.

name: Aranndanb
flavourText: As a key fuel and weaponry supplier in its sector, Aranndan wields unusual power in the diplomatic halls of the galaxy.

name: Archon Fail
flavourText: *Gotta Try Harder Next Time*

name: Archon Ren
flavourText: *Populated by small arboreal villages, this planet's only true urban center is the royal city of Kklaj.*

name: Archon Tau
flavourText: *The Xxcha home world and home to the renowned library of Xuun.*

name: Archon Vail
flavourText: *A former Xxcha colony, its extremely low temperatures create exotic molecular compounds that give the world its famed violet hue. Orbital facilities use the compounds in high-energy stardrive research.*

name: Arc Prime
flavourText: *Below the thin surface of atmosphere lie the continent-sized caverns of the Letnev. Rich in metals and energy, its vast fungus fields struggle to feed its population.*

name: Arcturus
flavourText: *Cold and still, with a surface buried beneath kilometers of ice. A few smuggler bases dot the surface, but Sumerian Station circles the planet, making it a vital trading destination.*

name: Arinam
flavourText: *Isolated planet poor in resources but rich in natural beauty. Boasts many exotic resorts frequented by the rich and famous of the galaxy.*

name: Arnor
flavourText: *Lush, green world that is renowned for some of the most fertile soil in the galaxy. Dominated by endless fields and the processing facilities of large agricultural firms.*

name: Arretze
flavourText: *Also called the "Moving Sand." The desert home of the Hacan Mowshir trade families and the great orbital trading ports of Haal, Shimax, and Dry Wind.*

name: Ashtroth
flavourText: *Covered in boggy landmasses and shallow seas. Algal blooms provide rich biomass for processed foods, but create smelly (and often toxic) offgassing.*

name: Astrea
flavourText: WIP

name: Atlas
flavourText: *Heavy grav world and former Sol colony famed for squat, strong inhabitants and strategic location. Visitors need support exoskeletons to move on the surface.*

name: Avar
flavourText: *Lighter than its companion worlds, Avar is riddled with caverns. The majority of the Atharal Torus lives in the bustling aeries within, sheltered from the radiation bursts emanating from nearby Phorus.*

name: Avernus
legendaryAbilityText: ACTION: Exhaust this card to use the Embers of Muaat's **STAR FORGE** faction ability without spending a command token.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: Gashlai energy/matter conversion has many uses.

name: Behjan
flavourText: The Couriel Plains of Behjan are notorious for its roaming mobs of cybernetically enhanced experimental subjects.

name: Bereg
flavourText: *A frozen world that is inhospitable to most races. Indentured laborers risk attacks from arctic sharaks in the infamous Iodinium mines.*

name: Bozgarbia
legendaryAbilityText:
When you explore Bozgarbia, draw 1 card from each planet exploration deck. Choose 1 to resolve, and discard the rest.
You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to explore Bozgarbia
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: *Thousands of years of garbage fills once majestic canyons, endlessly strewn over the moon's surface. Who knows what ancient treasure lays amongst the trash?*
flavourText: *A solitary moon, which orbits the home of a once-great civilization, and served as the principal repository for its waste material.*

name: Breakpoint
flavourText: Located nearby an inportant gateway. A great network of bunkers and military installations are interwoven both on the surface and deep underground.

name: Bunker
legendaryAbilityText: You may place an additional PDS on this planet. Your PDS on this planet have their range increased by 1.

name: Cahgaris
flavourText: Despite, or perhaps because of, its dangerous surface radiation, many influential criminal enterprises have contacts on Cahgaris.

name: Cantris
legendaryAbilityText: When you gain this card, gain 1 victory point; when you lose this card, lose 1 victory point. You score last during the status phase.
flavourText: Cantris is scarred by the violent invasions of warring galactic factions.

name: Casibann
legendaryAbilityText: When you exhaust Casibann to spend its resources or influence, you may exhaust this card to remove any number of infantry on that planet to spend them as resources or influence as well.
flavourText: A technologically backwards planet that is known for its unique religion. Its isolated populace worships starfaring vessels and their crew like gods.

name: Cealdri
flavourText: *Small cities huddle on the shores of the single ocean and avoid the arid continental interiors. Mentak ships hunt departing vessels carrying bespoke cybernetics.*

name: Centauri
flavourText: *Venerable world with few resources but a rich history. Site of important treaties between several races during the Twilight Wars.*

name: Cerberus
legendaryAbilityText: At the start of a ground combat on a planet you control, you may exhaust this card to choose 1 ground force in the active system; that ground force rolls 1 additional die during each round of that ground combat.

name: Cormund
flavourText: *A remote and sparsely settled Naaz-Rokha world destroyed during early entropic field tests. Now mining corporations harvest metals from the shattered core.*

name: Creuss
flavourText: *Trapped between matter and void lies the realm of the Creuss. Made of trapped light and radioactive gas, this realm hosts the most peculiar forms of life.*

name: Custodia Vigilia
legendaryAbilityText:
While you control Mecatol Rex, it gains SPACE CANNON 5 and PRODUCTION 3.
Gain 2 command tokens when another player scores a victory point with the second clause of the 'Imperial' strategy card.
flavourText: *Custodia Vigilia. The fully realized seat of the Keleres. A veritable fortress in the heart of Mecatol City. Ten thousand people come and go daily, and the Keleres see them all.*

name: Custodia Vigilia (Plus)
legendaryAbilityText:
While you control Mecatol Rex, it gains SPACE CANNON 5 and PRODUCTION 3.
Gain 2 command tokens when another player scores a victory point with the second clause of the 'Imperial' strategy card.

name: Dal Bootha
flavourText: *A populous planet whose resources have been severely depleted. Well-educated citizenry and many universities, but dependent on foreign imports.*

name: Darien
flavourText: *Ravaged by Sol and Letnev bombardments during the Twilight Wars. The Xxcha commit substantial resources to rebuilding its ecology and cleansing its toxic continents.*

name: Desmond
legendaryAbilityText: ACTION: Purge this card to draw 1 relic. Other players may draw 1 action card

name: Domna
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to remove 1 of your ships from the game board and place that unit in an adjacent system that does not contain another player’s ships. [Note: Place means ignore all anomaly restrictions. Transport is not possible with placing]

name: Druaa
flavourText: *Despite its oversized poles, Druaa is one of the most beautiful planets. Its flowered steppes, violet mountains, and glowing forests are famous across the galaxy.*

name: Dwuuit
flavourText: A year on Dwuuit is exactly a third of a year on nearby Uhott. Triannual street celebrations mark the passing of green Uhott far overhead.

name: Echo
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to place 1 frontier token in a system that does not contain a planet. [Note: only 1 frontier token can be in a system at any time]

name: Eko
legendaryAbilityText: foo bar

name: Elok Nu
flavourText: Largest of the Elok planetoids, it is home to the largest of the Empyrean outposts. It is here where volatile energies are harvested.

name: Elok Phi
flavourText: The Elok nebula is not the largest, but it has long been home to Empyrean outposts.

name: Elysium
flavourText: *Larger than a thousand terrestrial planets, Elysium is an artificial shell-world built around the powerful singularity in its hollow heart. Its surface is covered in calm seas and cultivated plants.*

name: Emelpar
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to ready another component that isn't a strategy card.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: Grandeur unrivaled, yet nothing but grandeur remains.

name: Erissiha
flavourText: A beautiful planet from orbit, Erissiha is an otherwise small planet with modest industry and political sway.

name: Ethan
legendaryAbilityText: foo bar

name: Everra
flavourText: *Ancient world of red seas and bare rocks. Locals live in wondrous nano-carbon cities built by a mysterious ancient race, and mine nearby nebulae for rare gases.*

name: Faunus
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card when you pass to gain control of a non-home, non-legendary planet that contains no units and has no attachments.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: The Maxis order has agents and scientists embedded in research teams all across the galaxy.

name: Fria
flavourText: *Brutally cold ice world populated only by a few scattered mining camps. Despite brutal climate, highly prized for its deposits of rare ores used in starship drives.*

name: Garbozia
legendaryAbilityText: Exhaust this card when you pass to place 1 action card from the discard pile faceup on this card; you can purge cards on this card to play them as if they were in your hand.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: Throw 'er on the 'eap with the rest.

name: Ghanis
flavourText: Sunsets on Ghanis glow violently orange in the low-horizon particulate waste of its massive industrial belts.

name: Ghoti
legendaryAbilityName: Money From Nuthin N Fish-Points For Free
legendaryAbilityText: When you move 1 or more ships into a system that contains no planets, gain 1 commodity. You may score objectives if your home system contains no planets.

name: Gral
flavourText: *Backwater planet with modest resources and an unassuming populace. Most noted for the reliable and affordable vehicles produced in its factories.*

name: Grywon
flavourText: Grywon prides itself on its colorful mycelium gardens, the remnants of its original biome, now wrapped inside heavily urbanised but environmentally homeostatic cityscapes.

name: Grywonb
flavourText: Grywon prides itself on its colorful mycelium gardens, the remnants of its original biome, now wrapped inside heavily urbanised but environmentally homeostatic cityscapes.

name: Hercant
flavourText: *Also called the "Fire Sand." Seat of the Quieron, the Hacan council, and the Sword Fleet. Harbors the greatest of the famous Hacan moving cities.*

name: Hersey
legendaryAbilityText: Before a player casts votes, you may exhaust this card to choose a player; that player must give you 1 promissory note from their hand, or cast at least 1 vote for the outcome of your choice on that agenda.

name: Heska
flavourText: The several private research stations dotting the large southern continent are responsible for the bulk of economic activity.

name: Hevahold
flavourText: The seas are polluted by an unknown ancient industrial disaster caused by the civilisation whose ruins cover the northern polar regions.

name: Hevaholdb
flavourText: The seas are polluted by an unknown ancient industrial disaster caused by the civilisation whose ruins cover the northern polar regions.

name: Creuss (Hexagon)
flavourText: *Trapped between matter and void lies the realm of the Creuss. Made of trapped light and radioactive gas, this realm hosts the most peculiar forms of life.*

name: Locked Mallice (Hexagon)
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to gain 2 trade goods or convert all of your commodities to trade goods.

name: Mallice (Hexagon)
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to gain 2 trade goods or convert all of your commodities to trade goods.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: *Founded by black market traders that fled through a wormhole and ended up in the space between.*
flavourText: *Trapped in a space believed to be beyond our universe, a shimmering world of strange energies and disconcerting warping of physical laws sitting at the heart of a strategically vital wormhole nexus.*

name: Hope's End
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to place 1 mech from your reinforcements on any planet you control or draw 1 action card
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: *Buried deep beneath the surface, the lost vaults contain a legion's worth of weapons.*
flavourText: *Buried in the Ichal Nebula. The Lazax used the toxic wildlife and fierce aurora storms to train their troops. Even now, volatile weapon caches remain hidden beneath its sands.*

name: Horace
legendaryAbilityText: foo bar

name: Hr'an Cus
flavourText: A sentient but pre-technological species remains quarantined in the western hemisphere. Relations with local colonies are strained.

name: Ikrus III
flavourText: The verdant surface of Ikrus III is dotted with artisanal manufacturing enclaves, and produces a significant portion of all artistic supplies in its sector.

name: Illusion
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to place up to 2 fighters from your reinforcements in any system that contains 1 or more of your ships
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: *Unsurprisingly, the triple-ace instructors emphasize strike-and-fade tactics and misdirection.*
flavourText: *Exists on no known charts and appears deserted to those who stumble across it. However, secretive locals live in cloaked cities heavily defended by swarms of starfighters.*

name: Industrex
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card when you pass to place 1 ship that matches a unit upgrade technology you own from your reinforcements into a system that contains your ships.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: The Mechanica have refined their prototyping facilities for generations.

name: Ixth
flavourText: *A dry, dead world of black volcanic mountains and molten seas of lava. The great necropolis of Aior Dol Gorgos on the Plateau Imperia is the only evidence of civilization.*

name: Jarrah
legendaryAbilityText: foo bar

name: Jeol Ir
flavourText: *Heavily industrialized world. Pollution has killed all life outside of dome cities, but twin suns provide constant power for factories and huge populace.*

name: Jol
flavourText: *Covered by cold oceans and a few inhospitable islands. The seat of the Headmaster, the Hylar ruler, dwells in the deep underwater city of Wun-Escha.*

name: Jord
flavourText: *Distinctly seasonal, with the greatest variety of climates and ecologies in the galaxy. The Federation of Sol rules the Jord humans from the great city of New Moscow.*

name: Kamdorn
flavourText: *Also called the "Dream Sand." The least populated of the Hacan planets, but the center of Hacan mythology and religion. The only known source of starflowers.*

name: Kan'His
flavourText: Financial, commercial and artistic industries thrive in the temperate climate, with some small military groups providing security.

name: Kelgate
legendaryAbilityText: At the start of your turn, you may exhaust this card to treat this system as if it had an alpha and beta wormhole until the end of this tactical action.
flavourText: The site of the first non-Cruess wormhole generation device. Powered by the heat from the planet's core. The shifting gates have led to it become an important trade hub.

name: Kraag
flavourText: *A heavily irradiated world known only for its dust mines. Recently a massive "tomb" of dormant Titans was discovered in the southern hemisphere.*

name: Kris
flavourText: The jagged coastlines of its capital city Havvas have begun to draw new entrepreneurial investments in recent times.

name: Kwon
legendaryAbilityText: When this card enters play, attach to it the unlocked commander of a random unchosen faction. While you control this planet, your commodity value is decreased by 1.

name: Kytos
flavourText: Located in between both an alpha and beta wormhole. Kytos has a unique composition, in terms of both populace and resources.

name: Lapidus
legendaryAbilityText: foo bar

name: Lazar
flavourText: *The only inhabited world in a forgettable system. Few native resources and only rudimentary, often underdeveloped, industries.*

name: Limbo
legendaryAbilityText: When a player would win a combat, you may exhaust this card to treat that combat as a draw instead

name: Lirta IV
flavourText: *Covered in vast swamps and fetid bogs. Home to rare biochemical compounds unique to its marshlands used in everything from exotic foods to biogenic drugs.*

name: Lisis
flavourText: *Primordial world with primitive native life. Potential for terraforming led to the infamous genocide of Saar settlements by Sardakk N'orr and ongoing conflicts between them and Naalu forces.*

name: Lisis II
flavourText: *The crystal caverns of Lisis II are the source of most of the Jorun colonists' water and foodstuffs. Notable for the great crescent-shaped valley of Gavar.*

name: Lloyd
legendaryAbilityText: foo bar

name: Locked Mallice
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to gain 2 trade goods or convert all of your commodities to trade goods.

name: Lodor
flavourText: *Wealthy planet ruled by powerful biotech consortiums. Rumored to harbor hidden caches of outlawed bacterial weapons.*

name: Loki
flavourText: *Cold and wracked with violent storms, Loki still hosts several Yssaril and human colonies, some of which have engaged in escalating shadow-conflicts.*

name: Lor
flavourText: *Wreathed in vast seas of methane ice. Sea floor drilling platforms harvest rare crystals used in advance computers and energy weapons.*

name: Lunerus
flavourText: Lunerus shows the cooling scars of tidal disruption, but the remains of those ancient volcanic eruptions still poison the air.

name: Lust
legendaryAbilityText: After you activate a system, you may exhaust this card to apply +1 to the movement value of up to 2 of your ships during this tactical action.
flavourText: Its barren surface has been worn smooth by constant storms. Ships have long been able to take advantage of these forces and have used them to great avail.

name: Maaluuk
flavourText: *Mostly pungent marshland and mudplains. Original world of the Naalu race, which now enslaves winged Miashan to work its great iron-extraction plants.*

name: Magrathea
legendaryAbilityText: The resource and influence value of Magrathea are each equal to the combined total victory points on face up public objectives.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: *The Magratheans are expert terraformers, with their homeworld being the crown jewel of their abilities. Rumors have started that they plan on building a planet from scratch in the near future.*
flavourText: *Located in the heart of the Horsehead Nebula, the planet looks a lot different from when it was last seen by the wider universe at the end of the Age of Dusk.*

name: Malbolge
legendaryAbilityText: At the start of your turn, you may exhaust this card to choose 1 of your neighbors; that player must give you 1 promissory note or 1 action card from their hand, if able.
flavourText: Boiling swamps cover the surface. Well hidden tunnels lead to fortifed bunkers. Sealed deep within are vast libraries, any record can be found stored within their info-matrices.

name: Mallice
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to gain 2 trade goods or convert all of your commodities to trade goods.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: *Founded by black market traders that fled through a wormhole and ended up in the space between.*
flavourText: *Trapped in a space believed to be beyond our universe, a shimmering world of strange energies and disconcerting warping of physical laws sitting at the heart of a strategically vital wormhole nexus.*

name: Maon-Lor
flavourText: A hub for manufacturing, trade and research, the glowing wormhole can be seen on dark, clear nights, drifting far in the sky.

name: Mayris
flavourText: A gas-giant renowed for its stunning polar auroras. Energy harnessed from Mayris's constant storms is used to power the various space ports.

name: Mecantor
flavourText: In place of a normal star, Mecantor orbits around a minor gravity rift. While within the habitable range, incoming ships must stick to pre-determined routes to avoid the dangers of the anomaly.

name: Meer
flavourText: *Hellish world immolated in the inferno of its nearby sun. Famed for the fiery majesty of its surface when viewed from the safety of its many orbital stations.*

name: Mehar Xull
flavourText: *Unstable radiation belts create hazardous living conditions but facilitate research in the electro-quantum propulsion technologies.*

name: Meko II
flavourText: Sheltered on the second satellite of the otherwise unremarkable gas giant Meko, the research facilities of Meko II are powered almost entirely by its hellish magnetosphere.

name: Mellon
flavourText: *Poor in natural resources but rich in exotic plant and animal life. Protected as a planetary xenological garden and lifeform preserve.*

name: Merjae
flavourText: Deep sea mining operations cloud Merjae's oceans, while its magnetosphere powers valuable engine research projects.

name: Migyro
flavourText: A mild world that has a Jord-like composition. It has served as a Federation outpost for many generations. Numerous shipyards have formed across the landscape.

name: Mirage
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to place up to 2 fighters from your reinforcements in any system that contains 1 or more of your ships
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: *Unsurprisingly, the triple-ace instructors emphasize strike-and-fade tactics and misdirection.*
flavourText: *Exists on no known charts and appears deserted to those who stumble across it. However, secretive locals live in cloaked cities heavily defended by swarms of starfighters.*

name: Moll Primus
flavourText: *In places lush and rich, in others a barren wasteland. This old Lazax penal colony has prospered under the rule of the governing Mentak Coalition.*

name: Mordai II
flavourText: *Mined to its bones by the virulent Nekro, Mordai II is reinforced by graviton energy beams that barely keep the world from collapsing in on itself.*

name: Mornn
flavourText: On the edge of a nebula and nearby to a volatile epsilon gate. This barren planet has served many roles under its many occupants, an outpost, a shipyard, a military colony, and countless more.

name: Mor Rock
flavourText: Covered in lush forests and unique geological formations. The populace mostly consists of natives and off-world researchers.

name: Mecatol Rex
flavourText: *Once a splendid place, now a sad devasted wasteland. Only the radiation-shielded Mecatol city, the seat of the powerful Galactic Council, remains habitable.*

name: Mecatol Rex
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn and discard 1 secret objective to draw 1 secret objective.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: Hic fiat opus galaxiae.
flavourText: *Once a splendid place, now a sad devasted wasteland. Only the radiation-shielded Mecatol city, the seat of the powerful Galactic Council, remains habitable.*

name: Muaat
flavourText: *The fiery surface of Muaat is uninhabitable to most races. It is home to the Gashlai, and only here can they live outside of their cumbersome ember suits.*

name: Naazir
flavourText: *A small planet of high mountains and deep, narrow seas. Cities and vertical farms burrow into cliff faces, while orbital factories produce high-tech consumer goods.*

name: Nar
flavourText: *Covered by mild oceans and a small archipelago called The Reef by off-worlders. The Circle of Regents makes its home in the underwater city-school of Nuun-Dascha.*

name: Nestphar
flavourText: *The fungal world of Nestphar is home to the symbiotic Arborec. Nestphar's orbit is filled with Flaah spores that extend its Symphony.*

name: Nevermore
legendaryAbilityText:
When another player activates a system adjacent to Mecatol Rex, gain 1 trade good.
Gain 2 command tokens when another player draws a secret objective with the second clause of the 'Imperial' strategy card.

name: New Albion
flavourText: *Rare atmospheric composition and biochemistry support lifeforms unlike any others in the galaxy.*

name: Nix
flavourText: Covered in thick ice sheets and permafrost. In the almost perpetual night, ice harvesters work for meager rations.

name: Nokturn
flavourText: Just as barren and hellish as the other planets in the Vili system. The only location of note are the Nokturn facilities located near the southern hemisphere.

name: Norrk
flavourText: Grassy plains with small dusty mountains. The local industry revolves around hunting Norrkian buffalo.

name: Oasis
legendaryAbilityText: At the end of your turn, you may place a destroyer from your reinforcements in a system that contains no planets and no other player's ships.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: *It is legend that deep within space, an oasis serves as a beacon of hope to lost ships.*
flavourText: *This rogue planet has eluded documentation for millennia. Its few reports have come from the lost crews that have claimed to have stumbled upon it. No expedition has ever been able to confirm its existence.*

name: Coral Reef
flavourText: Coral-analogues have evolved on many worlds, and their "reefs" are always areas of intense biodiversity.

name: Lost Fleet
flavourText: Although usually badly degraded by water and time, shipwrecks remain fascinating areas of exploration and study whether those ships sailed sea or stars.

name: Deep Abyss
flavourText: The Abyssal zone features such dramatic pressure that even most Hylar need assistance to survive in the lightless depths.

name: Brine Pool
flavourText: Sites with unique oceanic chemistry are of obvious interest to Deepwrought researchers.

name: Ice Shelf
flavourText: Drylanders frequently discount the scientific opportunities to be found beneath their own polar ice sheets.

name: Orchard
flavourText: Warm equatorial seas and vast agricultural fields have fostered strong trade with neighbouring systems.

name: Ordinian
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card when you pass to draw 1 action card and gain 1 command token.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: A shard of a greater whole, a part of a grand effort.

name: Ordinian
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card when you pass to draw 1 action card and gain 1 command token
flavourText: The Nekro Virus did something here once. Idk nobody cares about flavor text.

name: Origin
legendaryAbilityText: When you gain control of Origin, attach this card to a planet in your home system. That planet has +2 influence.

name: Perimeter
flavourText: *Former garrison world with fond memories of the Lazax. Maintains formidable military with informal ties to the Winnu. Perpendicular rings make orbital navigation difficult.*

name: Perpetual
flavourText: The molten surface makes it uninhabitable to most. Located extremely close to a supernova in a region known as the birthplace of stars.

name: Phylob

name: Plutus
legendaryAbilityText: At the start of the Strategy phase, you may exhaust this card and any number of planets you control to place a number of trade goods on this card equal to either the combined resource or influence value of those planets. When you ready this card, gain all trade goods on this card.

name: Primor
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to place up to 2 infantry from your reinforcements on any planet you control
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: *A clade of assassin-scholars has watched over Primor, pledged to its populace's survival.*
flavourText: *Large temperate world. Site of several pitched battles during the Twilight Wars due to valuable osmium deposits and a well- educated populace.*

name: Prism
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn and purge a non-faction, non-unit upgrade technology you own to gain 1 technology with the same number of prerequisites.

name: Prymis
flavourText: Seating at a more stable distance between the two wormholes. Prymis is the main space port. It's many orbital platforms service the thousands of ships that pass by.

name: Quann
flavourText: *Since the discovery of the Alpha Wormhole, this temperate planet with two continents and one large ocean has been a haven for traders and smugglers alike.*

name: Qucen'n
flavourText: *After the Twilight Wars, existed for centuries as a near-utopia of scattered communal farms free from governmental interference.*

name: Quinarra
flavourText: *Enormous and oceanless. Not only the largest planet supporting sentient life, but also the one with the least moisture. Home to the Sardakk N'orr hive-cities.*

name: Quwon
flavourText: Composed mostly from ice crystals and dust. Large orbital collection platforms are used to collect and purify the ice forms.

name: Ragh
flavourText: *The capital colony of the Saar and the epicenter of the Saar religion. Also called "Ragh's Call" by the Saar.*

name: Rarron
flavourText: *Large, populous world with three distinctive moons renowned for its biomodification clinics and cyber boutiques.*

name: Renhult
flavourText: A cold gas giant mostly used as a refueling station for military fleets passing through the system.

name: Resculon
flavourText: *Poor in natural resources, but a nearby nexus of major trade routes has brought it increasing wealth as interstellar commerce has intensified.*

name: Retillion
flavourText: *Darien is the heart of the brotherhood's realm. Here, within the great Monastery of Lucas, rests the Yin, the holy egg from which all the Brotherhood were made.*

name: Rexatol Mec
flavourText: A backwards planet with many odd customs. This is the seat of the old Winnu Empire. It is currently overseen by the Lazax Custodians.

name: Rhyah
flavourText: Thick, partially frozen glaciers shift around on strong undercurrents. Temperatures are well below freezing and the only signs of life are research outposts.

name: Rial Archon
flavourText: Located far from the galactic center, and further from watchful eyes. This lack of oversight has allowed for continued experiments with more temperamental drives.

name: Rigel I
flavourText: *Hot, innermost world of the Rigel system. Cities and native life cluster inland from the heavily alkaline oceans.*

name: Rigel II
flavourText: *Temperate world with expansive oceans. Covered in estates and resorts for the system's elite, with extensive fisheries that feed much of the rest of the system.*

name: Rigel III
flavourText: *Outermost world of the Rigel system, and extensively settled despite cooler climates. Boasts a diverse range of industries and research institutions.*

name: Rokha
flavourText: *Terraformed by comet-drops and Alliance biotech into a cool world with alpine forests and stormy seas. The city of Dormont Vault boasts the famous Exotic Energies Institute.*

name: Ryl Fang
flavourText: Massive biomes of mega-ferns cover most of the surface. When processed they are an excellent and renewable food source.

name: Sakulag
flavourText: *Jungle planet plagued by dangerous predators such as the arboreal razeden. Home to many exotic biochemicals and natural pharmaceuticals.*

name: Saudor
flavourText: *Prosperous planet with large native population and substantial industry. Extreme axial tilt results in long day-night cycle that some races find uncomfortable.*

name: Sehnn
flavourText: Sehnn gets its rusty orange color from a think layer of dusty iron rich top soil. The primary industry is to extract this iron and use it in a variety of steel products.

name: Selen Tu
flavourText: Relegated for industrial usage, the surface of Selen Tu has been marked by years of resource farming. Exotic woods are grown, milled, packed, and ready to be shipped off world.

name: Sem-Lore
flavourText: *Home to the Semanora, and heavily damaged in the Twilight Wars. Rustling warship hulks litter the rod-deserts, making it a war memorial and salvage site.*

name: Sentuim
flavourText: Large fleets of sightseer craft swoop low over the northern glaciers, pushing the limits of lift in the thin, cold atmosphere.

name: Shalloq
flavourText: *A mix of tundra, swamps, rivers, and dense forests. Home to the mysterious, chameleonic Yssaril, whose capital Wueca has eluded all attempts at cartography.*

name: Shigonas
flavourText: Shigonas is one of the better archaeological Lazax sites, and researchers and entrepreneurs flock to it despite the poisonous atmosphere.

name: Siig
flavourText: *World covered in frozen, cesium-laced oceans. Archives buried deep beneath the surface use the cold to preserve relics and operate massive computers.*

name: Silence
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to place 1 cruiser from your reinforcements in any system that contains 1 or more of your ships.

name: Sokaris
flavourText: Millions of visitors flock to viewing platforms around the vast super-volcano still erupting on the Erida platform of Sokaris's northern continent.

name: Solin Uo
flavourText: Home to idyllic scenery and a mild climate. Strict conservation efforts have left its surface mostly untouched. Woods harvested from Selen Tu are brought to master carpenters for luxury products.

name: Starpoint
flavourText: *Large planet with eight small moons that supply a wide range of valuable resources. Acidic rains and toxic storms make it an unappealing destination for tourists.*

name: Station 309
flavourText: Located along the popular Hydrian space route, this orbital station his one of many. Ringing around an energetic gas giant, it serves as a refueling station for passing vessels.

name: Stygain
legendaryAbilityText: After 1 of your infantry units is destroyed during combat, you may place that unit on this card. When you pass, you may exhaust this card to place each unit on this card on Stygain.
flavourText: Soldiers sometimes claim to recognise fallen comrades in the swirling fog.

name: Styx
legendaryAbilityText: When you gain this card, gain 1 victory point. When you lose this card, lose 1 victory point.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: The last memory of the universe before.

name: Syvian
flavourText: Famous for stunning views and unique mega flora. The rainbow grassy plains draw many visitors. On the Red Steppe the renowned Syvian Research Institute draws in minds from all over the galaxy.

name: Taal'Dorn
flavourText: Vast deserts cover the northern hemisphere while lush river lands dominate the southern hemisphere. The fertile southern soil has lead to a robust agricultural industry.

name: Tarrock
legendaryAbilityText: After an agenda is revealed, you may exhaust this card to predict aloud an outcome of that agenda. If your prediction is correct, draw 1 secret objective.

name: Tchi Gunn
legendaryAbilityText: During status phase you draw an additional action card.

name: Telahas
flavourText: Colloquially known as the Amber Eye for its striking orange hue, Telahas bears the scars of ancient core mining operations.

name: Tempesta
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card after you activate a system to apply +1 to the move value of 1 of your ships during this tactical action.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: The exotic matter of the rings is found nowhere else in the galaxy.

name: Tequ'ran
flavourText: *Desolate planet transformed into weapons testing facility for large defense consortiums.*

name: Tethn'Sekus
flavourText: Tethn'Sekus, though more stable than Tethn'Tirs, nonetheless remains mostly a tourist destination and exerts little galactic influence.

name: Tethn'Tirs
flavourText: Tethn'Tirs is a beautiful planet but is undergoing significant tectonic upheavals due to a recent gravitic disturbance. Nonetheless it remains a popular destination among those who can afford the risk.

name: The Dark
flavourText: *A massive nebula dominating the skies of many core worlds. Thick clouds of dust obscure its heart, a lightless refuge where Empyrean ships have congregated for millennia.*

name: Thenphase
flavourText: The atmosphere is a soupy hazy filled with Arborec Flaah spores. Only recently has this planet been reconnected to the Symphony.

name: Thibah
flavourText: *Burdened by overpopulation and low mineral content in the planetary crust. Historically used as a staging world for deep-space exploration and trade.*

name: Thigel
legendaryAbilityText: After you pass, you may place frontier token in up to 2 systems that do not contain a frontier token or a planet.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: The old orbital antenna array was dismissed as derelict space junk by federal agents. Acamar knew better.

name: Thunder's Edge
legendaryAbilityText: Gain your breakthrough when you gain this card if you do not already have it. You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to perform another action.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: Heirarch online. State your request.

name: Tir
flavourText: When the surface is visible through the poisonous thick storms of Tir, explorers sometimes catch glimpses of abandoned structures.

name: Torkan
flavourText: *Populous planet almost completely dependent on foreign imports to sustain the extravagant lifestyles of its citizens.*

name: Uhott
flavourText: The sprawling cities of Uhott are considered to harbor some of the best gambling dens in the galaxy.

name: Uikos
legendaryAbilityText: After a player gains a Path token, place 1 commodity from the supply on this card. At the end of your turn, you may exhaust this card to gain all commodities on this card

name: Ultimur
flavourText: Ultimur's high altitude floating penthouses provide beautiful views over the horizon for the wealthiest elite.

name: Ultimurb
flavourText: Ultimur's high altitude floating penthouses provide beautiful views over the horizon for the wealthiest elite.

name: Valk
flavourText: *Valk contains lodes of rare minerals and metals within its crust. Skyhooks bring ore shipments up from the surface to the open-air shipyards in orbit.*

name: Vefut II
flavourText: *Massive, rocky world cursed with extreme gravity. Underground cities support advanced research in antigravity technologies.*

name: Vega Major
flavourText: *Most of the population resides in orbital habitats supporting mining operations in the planetary ring. Surface colonization limited due to oceanic macrosquid infestations.*

name: Vega Minor
flavourText: *Famous for extremely shallow seas covering most of the surface and for the renowned Vega Propulsion Corporation. Stilt cities host vibrant multi-species populations.*

name: Velnor
flavourText: *Barren world of windswept rocks and thick, murky oceans. Lack of local lifeforms allows corporations to strip-mine the surface and test orbital kinetic weapons at the poles.*

name: Venhalo
flavourText: Warm equatorial seas have fostered a strong chain of island economies, resorts, and community organisations.

name: Vent
flavourText: Although much of the surface is blasted by weapons research, a well-established web of manufacturing guilds ensures that key habitable regions remain untouched.

name: Veyhrune
flavourText: Once a center for surface mining, now vast cultivated forests surround cities nurturing valuable financial and scientific programs.

name: Vigilum
flavourText: WIP

name: Viliguard
flavourText: Deep beneath the frozen soil are spawling mines. What little metal can be harvested are sent off the the facilities of Nokturn.

name: Violence
legendaryAbilityText: At the end of a ground combat on a planet you control, you may exhaust this card to roll 3 dice. For each result of 6 or greater, destroy 1 ground force on that planet.

name: Volgan
flavourText: Much of the surface has been cracked to access a veined marble highly prized in the construction industry.

name: Volra
flavourText: Poisonous and unstable, the gas pits of Volra provide abundant fuel for industrials who can manage the cost of retrieving them.

name: Vorhal
flavourText: *This icy world is wreathed by powerful storms, forcing inhabitants to live underground in geothermal vents. Pacifistic locals award yearly "peace prizes" to peacemakers across the galaxy.*

name: Vygar II
flavourText: Home to a few military outposts, the habitable areas of its surface are shielded by low orbiting magneto-arrays.

name: Vylanua
flavourText: Once the native creatures had been hunted to extinction for food, the small planet was reallocated to prototype experiments.

name: Wellon
flavourText: *Sky cities suspended in helium-rich atmosphere more noted for fantastic views than the small quantities of exotic elements harvested by their chemical mines.*

name: widmore
legendaryAbilityText: foo bar

name: Winnu
flavourText: *The shining cities of the Winnu are the last places where authentic Lazax art and culture are still revered.*

name: Wren Terra
flavourText: *Arid, windy, and populated primarily by predatory Daartar hounds. The Barony utilizes large swathes of its northern steppes for low-yield agriculture.*

name: Xanhact
flavourText: *Rebelled during the end of the Lazax Empire, and was bombarded to ash by a Lazax fleet as an example. Left by the Galactic Council as a memorial to Lazax tyranny.*

name: Xxehan
flavourText: *Known for genetically complex native lifeforms adapted to tainted atmosphere and biochemistry.*

name: Ylir
flavourText: *The smallest of the three planets in the Atharel Torus, Ylir is covered in kilometers of water. The Murmeration meets in platform cities that drift with the currents.*

name: Yncranti
flavourText: A large proportion of the galaxy's ornamental clay is dug from the wide deeps of Yncranti's mud wastes.

name: Zhgen
flavourText: A flat dusty desert of a planet, the strong winds kick up blinding sandstorms. It is known for the strange religon of its inhabitants.

name: Zohbat
flavourText: *Known for its highly intoxicating Zohlian whiskey and the planetary space elevator that links the surface with orbital stations and shipyards.*
